text:
alex: Heads-up — Acme (prod) is seeing intermittent 403s calling /v1/generate behind an edge proxy (CloudEdge). Spike started ~2026-03-16T18:12:10Z. Need repro steps, request IDs, and a debug bundle to escalate.
maya: Got it. Can you paste the request IDs and the raw curl they used? Also which customer org id?
alex: Org: 987654321. Two sample request IDs from the logs: req_e7a1c9f2 and req_b3f8d24a. Both returned 403 with signature errors. Customer sent this minimal curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ...customer_token..." \
  -H "x-org-id: 987654321" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "Hello"}' -v
```
They say it works from their host sometimes but fails when routed through CloudEdge.
tyler: Ops alert — ops-bot shows an edge proxy config reload around 2026-03-16T18:11:55Z (deploy edge-config@d4c3b2). Could be header normalization change. ops-bot: Deploy recorded: edge-config d4c3b2 by infra-ci at 2026-03-16T18:11:55Z.
ivan: Can you paste the service logs for those req ids? Any signature validation detail?
alex: Log snippet for req_e7a1c9f2 (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T18:12:11Z] req=req_e7a1c9f2 auth: signature check failed: expected=Base64(signed:v1:AAA...) received=Base64(signed:v1:BBB...) header-snippet="x-org-id: 987654321" forwarded-via="cloudedge-12"
```
Also for req_b3f8d24a: similar mismatch, canonicalization flag=true.
sharon: Classic header canonicalization thing — some proxies lower-case headers and our signature scheme signs header names in original case order. Quick repro: try both header casing variants locally.
sharon: Example reproducer cmds:
1) original-cased header (likely to fail if proxy changed casing)
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ...customer_token..." \
  -H "X-Org-Id: 987654321" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' -v
```
2) lower-case header variant (simulate proxy):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ...customer_token..." \
  -H "x-org-id: 987654321" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' -v
```
sharon: If the lower-case one fails while original-cased succeeds, proxy is rewriting header case or order. That will break our sig validation unless the edge preserves exact header canonicalization.
maya: Also try sending the same request with --http1.1 vs http2; some proxies normalize differently for h2.
alex: Quick test from my laptop: original-cased succeeds, lower-case fails with same req_e7a1c9f2-like signature mismatch. I captured the failing response headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
x-request-id: req_e7a1c9f2
error: signature_mismatch
```
tyler: Please collect a debug bundle from the customer including: tcpdump of the outbound to CloudEdge, raw outgoing HTTP request (headers + body), and the CloudEdge access log for the request. Use support-bot to upload. support-bot: Created ticket SPT-4829 and prefilled required artifacts checklist.
alex: I'll ask the customer to run two steps and upload to the ticket: (A) repro curl with -v using both header casings, (B) packet capture of the POST to CloudEdge (pcap filtered to dst host). Provide this curl they can run to collect raw request:
```
# capture raw request headers/body and response
curl -v --raw --http1.1 -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: 987654321" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"debug"}' 2>&1 | tee curl-debug-xorg.txt
```
alex: Also ask them to include the CloudEdge access log line for the timestamp and the inbound headers as seen by CloudEdge.
ivan: If they can’t capture pcap, ask for the exact value of Authorization header (or a truncated token) and both raw header dumps. We can replay locally.
sharon: Short-term mitigation: add header-normalization shim at our ingress that lowercases header names before signature verification and accepts both forms for a rollout window. Need eng-runtime sign-off.
tyler: I filed infra PR draft to preserve header case passthrough to backend (internal link). Will link to SPT-4829.
alex: Customer replied — they ran both curls, uploaded curl-debug-xorg.txt and CloudEdge access log. Support-bot: Upload received: curl-debug-xorg.txt (attached), cloudedge-access.log (attached).
ivan: I replayed the exact raw request from their curl-debug file and reproduced signature_mismatch locally with `--http2` and when headers were lowercased. Repro steps confirmed.
maya: Ok — escalate to eng-runtime with request ids req_e7a1c9f2 and req_b3f8d24a + uploaded bundle. Add note: impact = intermittent 403 for customers behind CloudEdge proxies.
sharon: Workaround for affected customers: have them add header preservation to proxy or temporarily use a token signed with our v2 signature scheme (which signs normalized headers). We'll coordinate rollout. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
alex: Thanks — I’ll add a short note to SPT-4829 with exact repro steps and link to the uploaded bundle. Will ping infra and eng-runtime for hotfix. :thumbsup:
